﻿param([ValidateSet('red','green','green-timer')][string]$Phase)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. "$PSScriptRoot/iam-model-local-meter-watchdog-fix-wait.ps1"
$base="$script:WatchdogRoot/.local/iam-model-local-meter-watchdog-fix/controls/$Phase"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $base -Force|Out-Null
$pwsh=Join-Path $PSHOME 'pwsh.exe'
$hung="$script:WatchdogRoot/.tools/iam-model-local-meter-watchdog-fix-hung.ps1"
$healthy="$script:WatchdogRoot/.tools/iam-model-local-meter-watchdog-fix-healthy.ps1"
$results=[ordered]@{phase=$Phase;started=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('O')}
try{
 $positive=Invoke-OwnBoundedProcess $pwsh @('-NoProfile','-File',('"'+$healthy+'"')) 'healthy-control' "$base/healthy" 3
 $results.healthyPassed=($positive.exit -eq 0 -and !$positive.forced -and !$positive.timedOut)
 $h=Invoke-OwnBoundedProcess $pwsh @('-NoProfile','-File',('"'+$hung+'"')) 'hung-control' "$base/hung" 2
 $results.hangPassed=($h.timedOut -and $h.forced -and !$h.rootAliveAtReturn)
 $before=$script:OwnedProcesses.Count
 try{Invoke-OwnBoundedProcess $pwsh @('-NoProfile','-File',('"'+$healthy+'"')) 'invalid-cap' "$base/invalid" 30.01|Out-Null; $results.invalidRejected=$false}catch{$results.invalidRejected=($_.Exception.Message -eq 'EXTERNAL_CAP_MUST_BE_POSITIVE_AND_LE_30_SECONDS')}
 $results.invalidNoSpawn=($script:OwnedProcesses.Count -eq $before)
 $results.passed=($results.healthyPassed -and $results.hangPassed -and $results.invalidRejected -and $results.invalidNoSpawn)
}finally{
 $results.finalCleanup=Stop-OwnProcesses $script:OwnedProcesses
 $results.ended=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('O')
 Write-OwnJson "$base/result.json" $results
}
$results|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12
if(!$results.passed){exit 1}
